paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: GERDA search for bosonic super-WIMPs (keV-scale DM) absorbed via axioelectric effect in HPGe detectors, mass range 60 keV to 1 MeV. Paper sets 90% credible interval upper limits on both g_ae (ALPs) and alpha'/alpha (dark photons); AxionElectron chosen as primary per the g_ae result. Full exclusion curve is only in Fig. 3 (not tabulated); the only explicit numerical value in text is g_ae < 3e-12 at 150 keV/c^2 (the dark photon counterpart is alpha'/alpha < 6.5e-24 at the same mass). Limits weaken toward 1 MeV due to falling photoelectric cross section; curve spans roughly 1e-12 to 1e-10 over 60 keV-1 MeV per Fig. 3 but points were not digitized.
